content.text:
I added `POST /api/patients/search`, which takes `{ "q": "..." }` as a JSON body so the name never appears in a URL or query string. It returns `{ results: [{ id, firstName, lastName, dateOfBirth }] }`, at most 20, for patients of the caller's own practice. Non-practitioners get 403, and a `q` shorter than 2 characters gets 400. Typecheck and the full test suite pass, including the new `tests/patient-search.test.ts`.

- **What changed:** a new `searchPatientsByName` in `src/repos/patients.ts` does the case-insensitive match on first or last name. It escapes `%` and `_` so they aren't treated as wildcards. The route is in `src/app/api/patients/search/route.ts`.
- **Practice scope, not care team:** I followed your spec and scoped results to the whole practice. CLAUDE.md says practitioners should only reach patients on their care team, so decide whether to add a care-team filter. A search by name that only finds your own patients would be one way to do that.
- **Audit:** nothing is logged or written to the audit log, so the searched text and the results stay out of both.
